<thought>The spectrum shows a classic 1 Da spaced isotopic envelope with decreasing intensities (≈8 % for M+1, ≈0.5 % for M+2, etc.), which matches the natural 13C/12C distribution. No 2 Da spaced pattern (Cl, Br) is present. Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
